currentSystemFindings.finding: Worker non-SATISFIED/non-RESEARCH_REQUIRED evaluation publishes task.phase=REPAIR directly.
EXECUTION and REPAIR both set execution=true, action.kind=IMPLEMENT and plan source-write scope.
All contracted WORKER phases expose IMPLEMENT_EXACT_READY_PLAN.
validateResponse persists trusted question IDs and numeric aggregates only and never echoes provider text.
Replay/currentness checks exist, but no prior-finding-linked candidate/evidence delta is required before another JEV cycle.

externalSources.finding: Failed prior trials call reflect before the next reset/step and inject reflection into the next prompt.
GEPA uses metric feedback and execution examples in a reflection step before proposing and evaluating a changed candidate.
EvaluationBatch carries trajectories; ProposalFn consumes current candidate + reflective dataset and proposal metadata carries parent iteration identity.
Official evaluator-optimizer workflow keeps feedback in graph state and conditionally loops to refinement.

decisions.phase: Add WORKER/LOOKBACK; do not hide lookback inside REPAIR.
decisions.jevRationale: Keep v1 typed/no-provider-text JEV response; derive deterministic failed-criterion finding set and let the actor diagnose.
decisions.materialProgress: Require candidate-tree delta for IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT and evidence-hash delta for INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE before another JEV provider dispatch.
decisions.repeatControl: Same finding signature routes LOOKBACK mode to STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION.
decisions.sharedSemantics: One pure scripts/blackboard-supervision.mjs module is consumed by local delivery/context/JEV and CI validation.
